At the center of the card is a circular portrait of Jyotika, who is smiling warmly at the camera. She has shoulder-length hair styled neatly, and her makeup includes defined eyebrows, long eyelashes, and a soft pink lip color. Jyotika is dressed in a black blazer with a deep V-neck blouse underneath. She is wearing a statement necklace with intricate gold designs that add a touch of glamour to her outfit.
